title: Mingus's lessons at two dollars and his bequest of the bass
summary: Callender charged about two dollars and says Mingus willed him his instrument.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: He was just starting the bass? Had he... He didn't even have a bass. His father bought him a bass, and that's... Buddy Collette and Britt Woodman told him, "You should play the bass." He was fooling with the cello, the trombone or something, he was very musical. But I started him on the bass. I gave him a direction.
He was in high school then, was he?

Yeah, he was still in high school or about to finish. Anyhow, I think I charged him about two dollars a lesson, and we'd go to a movie with the two dollars, or go buy some ice cream or hot-dogs. So I really didn't teach him for money. But anyhow, to prove what he thought of it and thought of me, he willed me his instrument when he died.
Yes, I have his instrument. He willed it to me.
